links.outcome: Readability of AI-adapted versus clinician-written patient leaflets (Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease and Grade Level)
links.effect: AI-adapted leaflets showed a slight reduction in readability; patient acceptability was comparable (39.6% no preference, 27.9% preferred AI, 32.4% preferred human leaflet).
links.quote: There was a slight reduction in the readability of the AI-adapted patient information leaflets.

unlisted_practices: Patient preference comparison of ChatGPT-adapted versus clinician-written patient information leaflets

screen.reason: Empirical survey evaluating patient perceptions and readability of ChatGPT-adapted patient information leaflets compared to human-written leaflets.
